# Recorded reading evidence

`bny.json` is a lossless subset of BNY’s retained September 18, 2026 report,
with the report SHA-256 and its own quality rules. It preserves the complete
checklist and discovery fields that the narrower chart-focus excerpt omits.
No criteria, grades or measurements were manufactured.

The browser reading suite combines these fields with the existing pinned BNY
bars and a clearly labelled **offline report shell**. This composite is a UI
test, not a production publication or a new scan. Variants for missing fields,
partial criteria and changed rule periods are separate in-memory clones.
Wrong-period and wrong-threshold controls change only the served presentation
script; they never mutate retained evidence.
